results.title: Adjuvant mFOLFIRINOX Fails to Improve Disease-Free Survival Over mFOLFOX6 in High-Risk Stage III Colon Cancer
results.description: Jaafar Bennouna, MD, PhD, discusses results from the phase 3 IROCAS trial comparing adjuvant mFOLFIRINOX with mFOLFOX6 in patients with resected high-risk stage III colon cancer, highlighting the absence of disease-free survival improvement, increased gastrointestinal toxicity, and the need for novel adjuvant strategies beyond pathologic risk-based chemotherapy intensification.
results.source: Health Management Professionals Global Learning Ne
